content.tagline: HIFU + SDM home beauty devices, engineered and produced in Korea
content.descriptor: BTF ("Beauty That Fills"), a Korean developer of dual-ultrasound home beauty devices and styling tools; product development managed in-house from concept to production
about: BTF ("Beauty That Fills") is a Korean developer of home beauty devices, introduced to Teranova at InterCHARM Korea 2026. Its flagship product, the Ultrasonic Duo, combines two ultrasound technologies — HIFU and SDM — in a single handset; per the company, it is the only at-home device that combines both in one unit. BTF also sells a Professional Hair Iron and, per the company, is developing a standalone SDM-only device.

BTF originated from a parent company specialising in heat-transfer decoration and injection moulding. This background lets the company manage the full product-development cycle in-house — concept, design, tooling, moulding, production and finishing — both for its own devices and for OEM/ODM partners.

As of September 2026, BTF states it has no exclusive distribution agreements in place, so no territory is closed to a new partner. The Professional Hair Iron is available for sale now; the standalone SDM-only device is in early development, with BTF targeting a launch window between January and February 2027 and specifications not yet finalised.

lines.name: Ultrasonic Duo
lines.note: A home HIFU + SDM device for lifting, firming and brightening — BTF's flagship product. Full specification, mechanism and clinical data are set out on its dedicated page.

lines.name: Professional Hair Iron
lines.note: Marketed as the Infinity-Styler, per BTF's material: an all-ceramic floating-plate iron with automatic safety shut-off. Available for sale now; OEM/ODM open (EXW, standard MOQ from 1,000 units, potentially negotiable for simple logo, packaging or body-colour customisation, per BTF's letter of 14 September 2026). Confirmed technical specifications, certification (KC/CE expected in October 2026, per the company), final MOQ, pricing and official English product photography are still pending BTF's October materials package.

lines.name: SDM-only device
lines.note: In development. Per BTF, it will add a fourth ultrasound frequency (1 MHz) to the existing 3/10/16 MHz set; the company targets a January–February 2027 launch. Specifications are not finalised and no product materials have been received, so no dedicated page is published for it yet.

tech.name: HIFU — deep tightening
tech.note: High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound at 7 MHz, targeting the 3.0mm dermis and a 4.5mm depth BTF calls the SMAS layer, to stimulate collagen — per BTF, the same mechanism used in professional clinic devices. BTF describes the 4.5mm depth as reaching "the same facial support layer treated in surgical facelifts" — a comparison made by the manufacturer, not an independent claim of surgical-equivalent results.

tech.name: SDM — surface brightening
tech.note: Super-dense Droplet Micro-ultrasound across three frequencies (3, 10 and 16 MHz), spreading energy over a wider area of the dermis than HIFU alone. Per BTF, this is the same protocol used in high-end aesthetic clinics.

tech.name: Fixed-cartridge design
tech.note: No cartridge to replace. BTF's own technical specification states that the side button ships pre-set to 1,000 shots on first use, then switches to unlimited output for the life of the device — a detail its marketing pages omit when they describe the device simply as "unlimited shots." Teranova states the qualified version here because it is what BTF's own specification document says.

tech.name: Gyro-sensor safety
tech.note: A gyroscope auto-pauses output after 3 seconds without movement and shuts the device off after 2 minutes, per BTF's specification.

content.exportNote: Per BTF (3 September 2026), the Ultrasonic Duo is available from a trial order of 10 units, with a minimum order of 30 units; the export price varies with order quantity and is not published. As of the same date, BTF states it has no exclusive distribution agreements in place, so no territory is closed to a new partner. The Professional Hair Iron ships EXW with a standard MOQ from 1,000 units, potentially negotiable for simple customisation; OEM lead time is about four months, ODM about one to two months, per BTF's letter of 14 September 2026.
